mentions.author: Kortaggio
mentions.why: Argues education tech predictions keep failing
mentions.quote: Reminds me of "This Will Revolutionize Education: No prediction has been made as often, and as incorrectly as that." [VIDEO] The main problem is that learning is hard, and occurs inside the learner's head, rather than anything external outside of the learner.

mentions.author: Hytosys
mentions.why: History of technology repeatedly promised to revolutionize education
mentions.quote: We definitely have had a long history of "this changes everything for education!"[1], but 15 years is a long time for internet infrastructure to change and spread. The article seems to allude to such innovations. [1] [VIDEO]
